title: Tulsa cops hunting ‘serial defecator’ wearing thong, mask and shower cap who terrorized local businesses
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Police are hunting a twisted “serial defecator” who has befouled several businesses in Tulsa, Okla. — often while wearing “only a thong, a cut-open mask and a shower cap.”

Cops responded to a shopping center south of the city center around 4:30 a.m. Wednesday night after receiving reports that a mostly naked man had repeatedly pooped in a dog waste bag and smeared it on the walls and doors of a business.

The owner installed a security camera to catch the deviant, who was wearing “only a thong, a cut-open mask and a shower cap,” spotting him performing the same grotesque act on several occasions, according to police.

In one video the man, wearing glasses and clad in red Crocs, a black cross-body bag, purple latex gloves and a black shower cap exposes himself to the camera before once again doing his business inside a doggie bag.

He’s also wearing a medical face mask that has been cut open and shows nearly his entire face.

Cops have responded to the area several times but have yet to track him down, and have issued a desperate call to get him off the streets before he strikes again.

“Help us find this guy,” the Tulsa Police Department pleaded on its Facebook page Saturday.

“Please, if you know where we can find him, we’d love to relieve these business owners.”

The Tulsa Pooper joins the ranks of other illustrious freestyle feces depositors in recent years, such as Colorado’s “Mad Pooper,” the “Parking Lot Pooper” of Ashland, Mass. and of course, New Jersey’s very own “Pooperintendent of Schools.“

A psychologist offered an explanation about the odd phenomenon of “serial poopers” as people seeking a rush by “pushing the envelope and getting to the edge of civil behavior.”
